item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "dbd60e1ba2e2d770285942d5a3c1d26040410ef412653ec041e22f00d0f605a8",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "For a real normed vector space E, fields q and production, and flux:E→E, requires spatial interval integrability of q at every time, temporal interval integrability of flux(q(x,·)) at every position, spatial interval integrability of production at every time, temporal interval integrability of every spatial production integral, and the balance identity on every choice of spatial and temporal endpoints.",
      "effect_on_target": "The sole hypothesis supplies all four integrability conditions and the identity Q_ab(t)−Q_ab(s)=∫_s^t [speed·q(a,τ)−speed·q(b,τ)]dτ+∫_s^t∫_a^b production(x,τ)dx dτ. The first conclusion repeats this entire hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "Requires spatial interval integrability of q at every time, temporal interval integrability of flux(q(x,·)) at every position, and the source-free balance identity Q_ab(t)−Q_ab(s)=∫_s^t [flux(q(a,τ))−flux(q(b,τ))]dτ for every a,b,s,t.",
      "effect_on_target": "With flux(v)=speed·v, this entire predicate is equivalent to vanishing of all iterated production integrals; its negation is equivalent to existence of one nonzero iterated production integral.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid structure from a commutative additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real addition and zero used in scalar action infrastructure; adds no hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "Algebra.id",
      "meaning": "Makes a commutative semiring an algebra over itself through the identity map, with scalar action given by multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures real scalar multiplication on each real coordinate is ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "Algebra.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar action from an algebra structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the multiplication action underlying speed·state.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction: both constituent propositions hold.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires all five top-level conclusions simultaneously and all conditions within the two local predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "CommSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure, retaining its operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real semiring infrastructure for scalar multiplication without changing the proposition's domain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "A densely normed field has a nontrivial norm, with the same underlying normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real scalar-field structure required by the derivative predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts a multiplicative monoid action from a distributive scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains ordinary real scalar multiplication in the continuity infrastructure for derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure from a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the same real scalar operations for the function-space module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two elements of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "All displayed integral identities are equalities in Fin 1→Real, equivalently equality at its sole coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existence of an element satisfying the given predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "The fourth conclusion asserts existence of real endpoints a,b,s,t with a nonzero production integral precisely when LocalDef002 fails.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains a field's semiring and division structure as a semifield.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports real scalar operations; introduces no sign restriction on speed or other reals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Filter.Eventually",
      "meaning": "The set on which a predicate holds belongs to the specified filter.",
      "effect_on_target": "Applied to the almost-everywhere filter, states that the derivative formula holds outside a null set of times.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin n is the type of natural-number indices strictly less than n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fin 1 has exactly the index 0, so q and production take one-component real vector values, not values in an arbitrary dimension.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates all indices in Fin n using finRange n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies finiteness of the singleton coordinate set for the normed function space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "Function.hasSMul",
      "meaning": "Lifts a scalar action to functions pointwise.",
      "effect_on_target": "The flux is the vector whose coordinate i is speed·state(i).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts the addition operation from the specified heterogeneous addition instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here it adds vectors coordinatewise, in particular adding boundary flux difference and integrated production.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation from its instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here it multiplies every state coordinate by the fixed real speed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Extracts the subtraction operation from its instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the exact signs: q(a,τ) flux minus q(b,τ) flux, and production integral equals final content minus initial content minus integrated boundary flux difference.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the specified derivative at the specified point, using its full neighborhood and that fixed base point.",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts existence and value of the ordinary real-parameter, vector-valued derivative of the spatial q integral at almost every time; it is not merely an equality involving a totalized derivative operator.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "Iff",
      "meaning": "Logical equivalence, requiring both implications.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both the zero-integral characterization and the nonzero-witness characterization are biconditionals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed scalar-space structure from an inner product space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the ordinary real normed-space structure on each coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "IsModuleTopology.toContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "A module topology makes the given scalar multiplication continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of real scalar multiplication needed by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "A topological ring satisfies the corresponding continuity requirements for a topological semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports continuity of the standard real scalar action without imposing continuity on q or production.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toIsModuleTopology",
      "meaning": "A topological semiring has a module topology for its action on itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real topology to continuity of scalar multiplication in the derivative's codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure",
      "meaning": "The type of measures on a specified measurable space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the measure objects used for interval integration and null exceptional sets.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike",
      "meaning": "Evaluates a measure on a set through its underlying outer measure, with values in the extended nonnegative reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the null-set condition defining almost everywhere meaningful, including for arbitrary exceptional sets.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure.instOuterMeasureClass",
      "meaning": "Measures satisfy the outer-measure interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Permits the specified real measure to define the almost-everywhere filter.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.toMeasurableSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the measurable-space structure from a measure space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the measurable structure on the real integration and time domains.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distinguished measure from a measure-space instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Every integral and the almost-everywhere statement use the same standard real volume measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.ae",
      "meaning": "The filter of sets whose complements have measure zero, constructed from the null-set ideal.",
      "effect_on_target": "The derivative identity holds for almost every real time with respect to real volume.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action of a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real scalar action used on vector coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "Monoid.toSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the associative multiplication structure from a monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the scalar-action instance chain with unchanged real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts a monoid structure while retaining its underlying elements and multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Does not exclude the real scalar zero; speed may be zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "MulAction.toSemigroupAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semigroup action underlying a monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the same scalar action in the derivative's continuity instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers, including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Used for the fixed coordinate count 1 and numeral elaboration, not as a spatial or temporal domain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "Ne",
      "meaning": "Inequality defined as negation of equality.",
      "effect_on_target": "The existential production integral must differ from the zero vector; positivity is not required.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the operations of a nonunital commutative ring in a structure that does not require associativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "A structural conversion for real topological-ring instances; does not alter real arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital, nonassociative ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides unchanged real operations for a topological-ring interface.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the commutative additive monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real addition and zero to the function-space module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the algebraic ring operations while forgetting norm requirements.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real topological-ring instance chain without introducing new data.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains the real norm and operations used in each vector coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Builds the additive seminormed group from the same norm, addition, and pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the coordinate seminormed additive structure required by the real normed-space instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the same semiring operations in a structure without an associativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Only supports real additive-module infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Keeps the usual real field and norm in derivative-related instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed commutative ring's norm, metric, additive operations, and multiplication while forgetting its unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies unchanged real structures for scalar-action continuity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the same norm, ring, and induced pseudometric as a seminormed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Does not weaken or change the actual real norm used by integration and differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts a normed field's algebraic field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real field operations to the scalar-module instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed field's ring, norm, and metric as a normed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the standard real topology and arithmetic used to establish scalar continuity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure from a normed space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real scalar multiplication and vector addition for the derivative codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Not",
      "meaning": "Logical negation, defined as implication to falsehood.",
      "effect_on_target": "Negates the entire LocalDef002 predicate in the fourth conclusion, rather than asserting a pointwise sign or negative production.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral using its specified instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets 1 as the coordinate count and 0 in integral comparisons as the zero vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "Gives a function space the pointwise module structure inherited from its codomain.",
      "effect_on_target": "The space Fin 1→Real is a real vector space with componentwise scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Pi.addCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Gives functions into additive commutative groups their pointwise additive commutative group structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes vector-valued derivative differences and integral identities use componentwise addition and inverses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Pi.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Function addition is (f+g)(i)=f(i)+g(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "Adds the boundary flux difference and spatial production integral at the sole coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Pi.instSub",
      "meaning": "Function subtraction is (f−g)(i)=f(i)−g(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "All content differences and boundary flux differences are componentwise differences.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Pi.instZero",
      "meaning": "The zero function takes the value zero at every index.",
      "effect_on_target": "Zero production integrals mean zero vectors, equivalently zero sole coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "Pi.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Equips a finite product of normed additive commutative groups with its standard finite-product normed group structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the norm for vector-valued integration; on the singleton real coordinate this is the absolute-value norm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "Pi.normedSpace",
      "meaning": "Equips the finite product with its pointwise scalar module and compatible normed-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows integration into Fin 1→Real with ordinary real scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Pi.topologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "The product topology, generated by the coordinate evaluation maps.",
      "effect_on_target": "The derivative uses the usual topology of a one-component real vector, equivalent to the real topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Transfers the ordinary real distance structure into the topology used for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal",
      "meaning": "Regards an RCLike field as a real inner product space with the real inner product and underlying normed real scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "At Real, gives the standard real normed-space structure; it introduces no complex-valued coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both independent variables, all endpoints, speed, and each state coordinate are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The usual normed real field has elements with norms between any two positive bounds.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the nontrivially normed real field needed for derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "The addition operation on real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Underlying addition for all componentwise vector sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The standard additive commutative group structure of the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real addition, zero, and additive inverses in the vector space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Real.instCommSemiring",
      "meaning": "The standard commutative semiring structure of the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real arithmetic for the identity algebra and scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "Real.instRCLike",
      "meaning": "Packages Real as an RCLike field with real part equal to the identity, imaginary part zero, and its standard complete normed-field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real inner product and normed-space instances while keeping the target entirely real-valued.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "Real.instRing",
      "meaning": "The standard ring structure of the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real operations underlying module and additive instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "Real.instSub",
      "meaning": "Real subtraction a−b is addition of a and the additive inverse of b.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines subtraction signs in all componentwise balance identities.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The real number zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the sole coordinate of the zero vector used in both equivalences.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "Real.measureSpace",
      "meaning": "The standard measure-space instance on Real, whose volume is real Lebesgue measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes Lebesgue integration and Lebesgue-almost-everywhere time quantification rather than an arbitrary measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The usual additive real group equipped with its real norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the normed structure of each coordinate for integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The ordinary real ring equipped with its standard norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies compatible real norm, arithmetic, and topology to the target's instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The ordinary real field equipped with its standard multiplicative norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the scalar field for vector integration and differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real distance is d(x,y)=|x−y|, with its associated uniform structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "The derivative uses ordinary real limits, not a discrete or other alternative topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The standard real semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real multiplication in the continuity proof for scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "Ring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring operations from a ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real arithmetic used by the function-space module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains the semifield's semiring, inverse, division, and associated operations as a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies a structural route to the real semiring without restricting its elements.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "SemigroupAction.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from a semigroup action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the same real scalar action in the continuity instances for the derivative codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains norm, pseudometric, and ring operations while forgetting the unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides unchanged real seminormed structures for the coordinate normed spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real topology used to establish continuity of scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric structure from a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the same real metric topology to the derivative's scalar-action instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Retains a semiring's multiplication, unit, zero, and natural powers as a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the multiplicative structure of real scalars; zero remains an allowed scalar.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts a semiring structure without requiring its multiplicative unit.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides unchanged real additive and multiplicative operations for module infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",

    "proposition_plain_english": "For arbitrary one-component real fields q and production on all real positions and times, and any fixed real speed c, suppose the spatial slices of both fields, the temporal slices of c·q, and the temporal functions obtained by spatially integrating production are integrable on every bounded interval, and suppose the integrated balance identity holds for all spatial and temporal endpoints. Then all these conditions continue to hold, and the iterated production integral equals the change in spatially integrated q minus the time-integrated left-minus-right flux. The source-free integrated balance predicate is equivalent to all such production integrals being zero; its failure is equivalent to one such integral being nonzero.
